description:
## Problem
The DuckDB verified evidence is the ART index, not the physical order. A successful CTAS or atomic sort rewrite is never recorded (`benchbox/platforms/base/sorted_ingestion.py:211-320`).

## Change (per gate D-1; option A expected)
- Record a successful rewrite in `_execute_ctas_sort` as an executed `post_load` statement with `mechanism="sorted_ingestion"`.
- Classify it per the decision (e.g. a non-blocking `attested` verdict), surfaced in the receipt and the Explorer drill-down.
- "Sort requested but no executed rewrite" is enforced by the reconciliation item as a dropped intent. `corroborate()` stays configuration-free (plan review F2).
- MotherDuck: wire `DuckDBTuningIntrospector` only if D-1 permits attested-only verification. MotherDuck creates no index.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- `attested` never counts as corroboration of a catalog-verifiable intent.
- Skipped or failed sorts still block.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`.
- Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- No live cloud runs without explicit user approval stating the command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop d39166ea.
- This item touches paths listed in the soundness manifest by `tuning-trust-paths-soundness-manifest-20261001`. The PR needs an external `Soundness review:` section (AGENTS.md) and must not auto-merge.
